subject: Quick intake — use case, concurrency, and demo window
messages:
From: Anna Patel <anna.patel@mosaicretail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Redwood — quick demo and traffic snapshot

Hi Markus,

We signed up for Redwood this morning (self-serve) and I was pointed to reach out for a short walkthrough to understand how we might use it for product search re-ranking and on-site personalization. High level:
- Use case: rerank search results with embeddings + small reranker; some contextual prompts for personalization.
- Typical queries: ~300k queries/day today, increasing to ~700k over Q3.
- Concurrency: spikes to ~120 concurrent inference requests during promos; baseline often 8–20 concurrent.
- Desired timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks, production by end of Q3.

Attached a tiny sample of traffic (headers + event rates). We’re not strict about SSO for the demo but will likely require SSO & SOC 2 documentation deeper in procurement.

Would appreciate 30 minutes to see: an example pipeline, what latency & cost profile to expect, and any sandbox steps we should prepare. I’m cc’ing our infra alias so they can weigh in on windows.

Thanks —
Anna
Anna Patel
Head of Search & Personalization
Mosaic Retail
[Attachment: sample_traffic.csv (csv)]

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Patel <anna.patel@mosaicretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — quick demo and traffic snapshot

Hi Anna — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the sign-up + the sample. I looped in Ben (solution architect) and Irene (onboarding) so we can cover both technical fit and next-steps for a pilot. A few quick questions so we come prepared:

1) Concurrency: when you say ~120 concurrent during promos, is that sustained for minutes or short bursts? Any idea of token/seq length per request (free-text query only vs. multi-turn)?
2) Traffic shape: do you have 1) a per-hour day-of-week view and 2) an estimate of 95th percentile QPS during peak?
3) Pilot scope: do you want a narrow reranker POC (re-rank only) or a combined ranking+personalization pipeline?
4) Sandbox access: are you ok with a temporary data sandbox and synthetic keys for the demo?

If you’re open to it, propose three 30-minute slots next week and we’ll pencil one in. Alternately here’s our quick scheduler: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30?month=2026-04

We’ll include a short agenda and a lightweight throughput checklist.

—
Markus Klein
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Anna Patel <anna.patel@mosaicretail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: DevOps Team <infra@mosaicretail.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — quick demo and traffic snapshot

Thanks Markus — answers below inline.

1) Concurrency: promo spikes are typically 8–10 minutes (sustained for that window), can hit 100–140 concurrent for that period. Outside promos, steady-state concurrency is usually <25.
2) Traffic shape: I’ve uploaded an hourly CSV for the last 30 days here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C4D/view (same as attached sample for the immediate look). 95th percentile QPS is ~210.
3) Pilot scope: start with reranker only (we want to validate improvement lift first), then consider personalization as phase 2.
4) Sandbox: fine for the demo; we’ll scrub PII and provide sample keys.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Mar 16 — 10:00–10:30
- Wed Mar 17 — 14:00–14:30
- Thu Mar 18 — 09:00–09:30

Ben/Irene — feel free to propose alternatives or ask for more details.

Best,
Anna

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Patel <anna.patel@mosaicretail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — quick demo and traffic snapshot

Anna — thanks for the detail and the drive link. Quick notes from my side (so the demo is focused):

- Recommended demo length: 30 minutes. First 10 min: architecture and how reranker fits into pipeline. Next 15 min: live run on a small sample (we’ll use synthetic keys/scrubbed data). Last 5 min: next steps (pilot sizing & timeline).
- For peak promo behavior (8–10m bursts at ~120 concurrency), we typically show both queued & low-latency serving paths — will show a simple batching strategy that keeps p95 latency sub-200ms for reranker-only requests.
- Please attach the traffic_matrix.xlsx (hourly + webhook rates) if you have it — that helps our quick sizing.

I uploaded a short internal checklist and a starter agenda we use for reranker POCs and attached it here.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
